newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-Kesko '96 profit seen flat vs '95.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Kesko '96 profit seen flat vs '95.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 685 million markka median forecast for wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 13 analysts, EPS by 12 analysts).
Kesko's results are due on February 13.
In 1995, Kesko had a 689 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, six of the 15 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 688 million markka (mean 691 million) in an 624-763 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson Securities, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
